title:
A page layout for a page that has both page content and a navigation menu.
This layout does not extend {@link UiSdlLayoutBase} because `children` is replaced by multiple specific {@link UiSdlComponentRef}.
For layout usage in most cases, refer to {@link UiSdlLayoutNavMenu}. This layout is created for UI Designer purposes.
name: UiSdlLayoutNavigation
